Application Data.NAME: Joe's Family Diner
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Joe's Family Diner is a family-owned restaurant dedicated to providing a welcoming atmosphere and serving high-quality comfort food, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner options. Our menu features a diverse range of classic diner favorites made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. We implement rigorous food safety protocols to ensure the health of our customers and regularly maintain our kitchen equipment to minimize fire risks. Additionally, we offer delivery services using our fleet of insured vehicles, ensuring safe and timely service. We prioritize customer satisfaction and community engagement through local events and partnerships, fostering a family-friendly environment for all ages.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On December 10, 2022, a slip and fall incident occurred in the dining area due to spilled liquid, resulting in a claim of $2,000. The claim was settled and closed in January 2023. On March 15, 2023, a kitchen fire started due to equipment malfunction, causing $3,000 in damages. The fire was contained without injuries, and the claim is currently under review for coverage approval.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing, on-site security personnel during peak hours, and surveillance cameras installed throughout the premises.
